scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @apv/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @apv/storage typecheck && pnpm typecheck:preview
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @apv/core test && pnpm test:preview && pnpm test:surface
scripts.lint: eslint packages/core/src packages/core/tests packages/core/examples packages/storage experiments/core-walkthrough/run.mjs --max-warnings=0 experiments/core-preview packages/storage-host-validation packages/vscode-surface
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json packages/core packages/storage "experiments/core-preview/*.{ts,mjs,html,css,json,md}" packages/vscode-surface
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json packages/core packages/storage "experiments/core-preview/*.{ts,mjs,html,css,json,md}" packages/vscode-surface
